# Streamer Attendance Monitoring Database

## Project Overview
This is a Node.js/Express web application for tracking streamer attendance with features for:
- Tracking active/offline status
- Recording attendance timestamps  
- Viewing attendance reports and statistics
- Managing streamer profiles
- Exporting attendance data to CSV

- [ ] Create run task
- [ ] Launch the project

## Technology Stack
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express.js
- **Frontend**: React
- **Database**: SQLite
- **Additional**: cors, dotenv, better-sqlite3
